title: DataTable: retire the onBatchSave slot once list inline edit saves each cell on its own
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUYnzYCcbcpABdW7ps

Filing gate: ④ child of the coordination parent #35683 (list inline-edit redo). Source: the seat's ruling on the #35685 split (thread b1-I2): keep the slot declared in the per-cell save slice, stop wiring it, and retire it on its own card under ADR-0087.

## What is left

`DataTableSchema.onBatchSave` is a published slot of `@object-ui/types` (`ui/packages/types/src/data-display.ts` around line 1776, with its zod mirror in `ui/packages/types/src/zod/data-display.zod.ts`). Today the table calls it from "Save All" on the pending-changes bar, and `ObjectGrid` supplies `onBatchSave ?? defaultBatchSave` (`ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx`, `defaultBatchSave`). Read on main `a8126d24`.

#35685 replaces the bar with a per-cell save: each committed cell sends one update for its record, and the card rules out a table-wide "Save All" and any request that merges several rows. Its first slice stops wiring `defaultBatchSave` and leaves the slot declared, so after that slice lands `onBatchSave` is a declared slot no renderer calls: a host that sets it gets nothing, silently.

## Why

A declared slot that nothing calls is a promise the runtime does not keep (AGENTS.md Prime Directive 10). A host author reading the type would wire a batch handler and never see it run.

## Done when

- `onBatchSave` is removed from `DataTableSchema` and its zod mirror, with the ADR-0087 disposition stated in the changeset and the FROM-TO line (FROM `onBatchSave` TO the per-row `onRowSave`, one call per record).
- The jsdoc that names `onBatchSave` beside `onRowSave` / `onCellChange` (`data-display.ts` around lines 1544 and 1926) is rewritten.
- `git grep onBatchSave ui/` answers zero outside the conversion entry and its tests; the parity pins in `ui/packages/types/src/__tests__/` move with it.

Start after the per-cell save slice of #35685 lands (its PR stops calling the slot).

Grading: Task · suggested p2 (epic child, seat's word) · reach: hosts that wire `DataTableSchema.onBatchSave` in code · evidence: the read above on `a8126d24`.

Reader: the `domain:ui` lane, after the #35685 slice merges.

Dedupe: `onBatchSave` (objectstack issues, open) → 0.
